verdict.rationale: Sumsub explicitly documents Reusable KYC, letting clients share verification data via agreement with other Sumsub clients so applicants can reuse a prior passed check instead of re-running full verification. This directly matches the story's theme of recognizing and reusing a verified identity across products/sessions. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of reuse working across separate live products, and no detail on cross-session recognition mechanics (e.g., token/session persistence) beyond the Reusable KYC agreement model.
